sentences.text: 4. The appellant has been arrested on 18.06.2025 in connection with Crime No.212/2025 registered at Police Station - Mungaoli, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 78 of BNS, 2023, under Sections 376, 34 of IPC and under Sections 3(1)(w)(ii) and 3(2)(va) of the Act, 1989.

sentences.text: prior to her marriage but after the marriage, the appellant threatened her that he will viral her video and photograph on social media and committed rape with her.
Thereafter, she made a written complaint before Police Station Mungaoli.
Accordingly, offence has been registered.
6. Learned counsel for the appellant contended that the appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the matter.
He is in custody since 18.06.2025.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.
Prosecutrix is major and matured lady.
She was having love affair with the appellant prior to her marriage.
FIR is about 11 years belated.
Husband of the prosecutrix is working in Police Department, due to which, prosecutrix lodged false FIR against him.
No video or photograph related to the prosecutrix has been recovered from his mobile phone.
Appellant is a permanent resident of District Shivpuri and there is no possibility of his absconding or tampering with the prosecution case.
Final conclusion of trial will take long time.
Hence, he prays that the appellant may be enlarged on bail.
7. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the criminal appeal and prays for its rejection but fairly admits that the appellant has no criminal history.

8. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
9.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix is major and matured lady, she herself NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:16465 3 CRA-7221-2025 admits in her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
that she was having love affair with the appellant and she was having physical relationship with the appellant prior to her marriage

, FIR is about 11 years belated without any explanation, prior to incident prosecutrix did not make any complaint against the appellant, investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed and final conclusion of trial will take long time, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case for grant of bail to the appellant.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the criminal appeal is allowed and impugned order dated 24.06.2025 is hereby set aside.

10. It is directed that the appellant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court with a direction that he shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
11.
With the aforesaid, present criminal appeal stands allowed and disposed of.
12. Certified Copy as per rules.
(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE (alok)
